title: Tank Tussle
description: Two tiny tanks, one maze, shells that bounce off every wall. Line up a bank shot, dodge your own ricochet, and win five rounds before your mate does. A new arena every round. No friend handy? The CPU is happy to blow you up.
instructions: Player 1: W/S to drive, A/D to turn, Space to fire. Player 2: arrow keys to drive and turn, Enter to fire. Solo players can use either set. On a phone, left thumb drives and tapping the right side fires.
